heading: Applications
subtitle: Long-lived business systems consuming AI. Each application has an owning group and can be consumed by API keys across multiple groups.

migration.description: Migrate active legacy keys by completing their consumption group, application and environment once. Existing request history stays unchanged.
migration.disableHint: Disabling an application rejects new requests after the authentication cache expires (default TTL: 1 minute). Already-started requests and streams are not interrupted.

attribution.heading: Attribution overview · Last 24 hours
attribution.noCosts: No cost records in this window
attribution.keyHint: Counts non-revoked keys missing a consumption group, application or environment, including expired keys and disabled tenants. This is not a count of callable keys or a share of traffic.
attribution.historyHint: Requests without a recorded application are unattributed. Historical missing fields stay unknown; asynchronous request and usage records may lag or be incomplete. Costs are grouped by recorded currency and are not a financial balance.

attribution.forbidden: The attribution overview requires usage.read permission.
